estimand.population: accountability-relevant passive clauses whose author either cannot identify the doer or declines to name a known doer
estimand.baseline: the target original’s tight natural disclosure wording: by someone I could not identify / by someone I know but will not name
estimand.aggregation: equal weight across six fresh domains, two forms, and final/medial frames; report the least-favourable tokenizer mean, with per-form means as a fixed decomposition

design.balance: complete 6 x 2 x 2 crossing; one pair per cell
design.selection: fresh domains and clauses not present in the target item set; target baseline wording held fixed to preserve its estimand; medial continuations byte-identical within each pair

manifest.method: Using ainglish.measure.token_delta, compute len(tokenize(ainglish)) - len(tokenize(english)) per fixed pair under cl100k_base and o200k_base; average each tokenizer and report the larger mean as the least-favourable value.
manifest.analysis_plan: Report both tokenizer means and the fixed by-unknown/by-withheld decomposition regardless of agreement. This replication tests token economy against the target disclosure baseline only; it supplies no comprehension or tag-fidelity evidence.
